fathom.name: Fathom
fathom.description: Headphones, earbuds and speakers with a focus on sound.

products.name: Fathom Stillwater Headphones
products.short: Over-ear headphones with hybrid noise cancelling and a battery that lasts 40 hours.
description: Stillwater headphones use four microphones to cancel the low hum of trains, planes and office air conditioning, so you can listen at a lower volume.
The cushions are soft protein leather, and the headband adjusts in small steps for a secure fit. Folded flat, they slip into the included case.

products.name: Fathom Drift Earbuds
products.short: Light wireless earbuds with a pocket-sized charging case. Choose black or white.
description: Drift earbuds weigh five grams each and sit securely during a run. Tap either earbud to pause, skip or answer a call.
The case adds three full charges, and ten minutes of charging gives an hour of listening.

products.name: Fathom Pebble Speaker
products.short: A small waterproof speaker with a loud, clear sound and a 12-hour battery.
description: Pebble fits in a jacket pocket and survives a drop in the pool. Pair two for stereo sound in a larger room.

products.name: Aster Vela Phone
products.short: A compact 5G phone with a bright 6.1-inch OLED screen and all-day battery.
description: Vela is sized for one-handed use, and its screen is bright enough to read outdoors.
It charges over USB-C and on any wireless charging pad.

products.name: Bytewell Notebook 14
products.short: A light 14-inch laptop with 16 GB of memory for work and travel.
description: At 1.3 kg the Notebook 14 is easy to carry all day, and the battery lasts through a long flight.
Two USB-C ports charge the laptop and drive an external display.

products.name: Aster Orbit Watch
products.short: A smartwatch with a week of battery, heart-rate tracking and a swim-proof design.
description: Orbit tracks steps, sleep and heart rate, and shows notifications from your phone.
It is water resistant to 50 metres, so you can wear it in the pool.

products.name: Bytewell 10K Power Bank
products.short: A slim 10,000 mAh power bank that charges a phone about twice.
description: Fast 20 W charging over USB-C takes most phones to half charge in about 30 minutes.

products.name: Bytewell 30W USB-C Charger
products.short: A compact 30 W wall charger that fast-charges phones and powers small laptops.
description: The folding pins keep it flat in a bag, and 30 W over USB-C is enough to fast-charge a phone or run a small laptop.

choosing-wireless-earbuds.title: Choosing wireless earbuds
choosing-wireless-earbuds.excerpt: Fit, battery and water resistance: the three things that matter most.
content: The best earbuds are the ones that stay in your ears. Try the included tips in each size before deciding they do not fit.
Look at the battery life of the earbuds and of the case separately. Seven hours in the earbuds covers most days.
IPX4 means the earbuds handle sweat and rain, which is enough for running.

power-bank-basics.title: Power bank basics
power-bank-basics.excerpt: What the mAh number means, and how many charges to expect.
content: A 10,000 mAh power bank does not charge a 5,000 mAh phone twice in full. Some energy is lost as heat, so expect about 1.8 charges.
For fast charging, check that both the power bank and your cable support at least 20 W over USB-C.

picking-a-laptop-for-work-and-travel.title: Picking a laptop for work and travel
picking-a-laptop-for-work-and-travel.excerpt: Weight, battery life and ports: what matters when your laptop goes everywhere with you.
content: A laptop you carry every day should weigh well under 1.5 kg. Every 100 g matters by the end of a long journey.
Look for a real-world figure of at least 10 hours of web browsing, not the best case on the box.
Two USB-C ports that charge the laptop and drive a display will cover most desks and hotel rooms.
